REPUBLIC OF VANUATU
Assent: 14/10/2013
Commencement: 27/11/2014
STATUTE LAW (MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS)
ACT NO. 19 OF 2013
An Act to provide for amendments to certain Acts.
Be it enacted by the President and Parliament as follows-
1 Amendment
The following Acts are amended as set out in the Schedule:
(1) Vanuatu Agriculture College Act [CAP 314];
(2) Business Names Act [CAP 211];
(3) E-Business Act [CAP 264];
(4) Employment Act [CAP 160];
(5) Financial Institution [CAP 254];
(6) Incorporated Cell Companies Act No. 25 of 2009;
(7) International Banking Act [CAP 280];
(8) International Companies Act [CAP 222];
(9) Mines and Minerals Act [CAP 190];
(10) National Bank of Vanuatu Act [CAP 209];
(11) Police Act [CAP 105];
(12) Protected Cells Companies Act No. 37 of 2005;
(13) Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [CAP 229];
(14) Vanuatu Interactive Gaming Act [CAP 261];
Statute Law (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act No. 19 of 2013 2

(15) Vanuatu National Provident Fund Act [CAP 189].
2 Repeal of Act
(1) This Act is repealed on the day following the day on which all of the
provisions of this Act have commenced.
(2) The repeal of this Act does not, because of the operation of section 11 of
the Interpretation Act [CAP 132], affect any amendment made by this Act.
3 Commencement
This Act commences on the day on which it is published in the Gazette.
